achievements.name: Centaur Slayer
achievements.description: A few more centaur herds are thinned out.
achievements.requirement: Kill  centaurs.

achievements.name: Teamwork Gets It Done
achievements.description: Kills that involved at least one profession combo with another player.
achievements.requirement: Kill  enemies using profession combinations with another player.

achievements.name: Skritt Slayer
achievements.description: Scrape these scavengers off the surface of Tyria.
achievements.requirement: Kill  skritt.

achievements.name: Harpy Slayer
achievements.description: Clip the wings of these she-beasts.
achievements.requirement: Kill  harpies.

achievements.name: Drake Slayer
achievements.description: Enough of these massive drakes on Tyria's massive plains.
achievements.requirement: Kill  drakes.

achievements.name: Spider Slayer
achievements.description: They should have used their eight legs to run away from tougher fighters.
achievements.requirement: Kill  spiders.

achievements.name: Indiscriminate Slayer
achievements.description: If small things were meant to live, they'd have bigger teeth or faster feet.
achievements.requirement: Kill  ambient creatures.

achievements.name: Bandit Slayer
achievements.description: All criminals eventually meet a dark end.
achievements.requirement: Kill  bandits.

achievements.name: Emergency Response Hero
achievements.description: Always willing to lend a hand, or sword, for the common good. You go where the action is.
achievements.requirement: Participate in  events.

achievements.name: Gold Hoarder
achievements.description: Money is truly no object for you.
achievements.requirement: Have  coins in the wallet at one time.

achievements.name: Skillful
achievements.description: Your range of skills is quite impressive.
achievements.requirement: Earn  hero points by completing hero challenges or by gaining a level with a level 80 character.

achievements.name: Krytan Explorer
achievements.description: You've explored the war-torn hills of humanity's home.
achievements.requirement: Explore all areas in Kryta.

achievements.name: Thirst Slayer
achievements.description: Continuing a valiant battle against dehydration.
achievements.requirement: Consume  drinks.

achievements.name: All You Can Eat
achievements.description: No stranger to Tyrian cuisine.
achievements.requirement: Consume  items of food.

achievements.name: Tinkerer
achievements.description: Two helms really are better than one.
achievements.requirement: Transmute  items.

achievements.name: Skale Slayer
achievements.description: It's not polite to eat the dead.
achievements.requirement: Kill  skale.

achievements.name: Staff Master
achievements.description: A staff has many uses—all deadly.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a staff.

achievements.name: Sword Master
achievements.description: A classic weapon that grows more effective in your hand.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a sword.

achievements.name: Dagger Master
achievements.description: A slim, elegant blade with so many uses.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a dagger.

achievements.name: Longbow Master
achievements.description: Kill 'em before they reach you? Kill 'em before they see you!
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a longbow.

achievements.name: Axe Master
achievements.description: It's not the prettiest weapon in the armory, but it slices beautifully.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a axe.

achievements.name: Scepter Master
achievements.description: Nothing weaves a web of magic like a fine scepter.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a scepter.

achievements.name: Bat Slayer
achievements.description: Consider these winged rats cut down.
achievements.requirement: Kill  bats.

achievements.name: Shell Slayer
achievements.description: Even the creatures in the deep aren't safe from harm.
achievements.requirement: Kill  crustaceans.

achievements.name: Devourer Slayer
achievements.description: Devourers may be ugly, tough, and dangerous, but they're still prey for a skilled adventurer.
achievements.requirement: Kill  devourers.

achievements.name: Dredge Slayer
achievements.description: Become the enemy of the collective by killing dredge.
achievements.requirement: Kill  dredge.

achievements.name: Elemental Slayer
achievements.description: Fire, earth, lightning, water, and ice can't stand up to steel and magic.
achievements.requirement: Kill  elementals.

achievements.name: Ettin Slayer
achievements.description: Just goes to show: two heads are not better than one.
achievements.requirement: Kill  ettins.

achievements.name: Ghost Buster
achievements.description: Send the spirits into the Mists so they can rest in peace.
achievements.requirement: Kill  ghosts.

achievements.name: Fish Slayer
achievements.description: Gut the scaly swimmers to catch an achievement this big.
achievements.requirement: Kill  fish.

achievements.name: Giant Slayer
achievements.description: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.
achievements.requirement: Kill  giants.

achievements.name: Griffon Slayer
achievements.description: Hunting these formidable beasts has been a Tyrian pastime for centuries.
achievements.requirement: Kill  griffons.

achievements.name: Grawl Slayer
achievements.description: They should have worshipped you. At least they'd still be alive.
achievements.requirement: Kill  grawl.

achievements.name: Hylek Slayer
achievements.description: Cull these aggressive amphibians.
achievements.requirement: Kill  hostile hylek.

achievements.name: Flame Legion's Bane
achievements.description: Smoke out Baelfire's minions, and show them what real power looks like.
achievements.requirement: Kill  members of the Flame Legion.

achievements.name: Imp Slayer
achievements.description: Don't worry. Demon blood is easy to wash out.
achievements.requirement: Kill  imps.

achievements.name: Inquest's Bane
achievements.description: If they are so smart, how come they couldn't stop from getting killed?
achievements.requirement: Kill  members of the Inquest.

achievements.name: Insect Slayer
achievements.description: Squish these creepy crawlies.
achievements.requirement: Kill  insects.

achievements.name: Jotun Slayer
achievements.description: These creatures used to be powerful and great kings. Now, dead.
achievements.requirement: Kill  jotun.

achievements.name: Krait Slayer
achievements.description: Make it safe to go back in the water.
achievements.requirement: Kill  krait.

achievements.name: Minotaur Slayer
achievements.description: Half-man, half-bull, all dead.
achievements.requirement: Kill  minotaurs.

achievements.name: Nightmare Court's Bane
achievements.description: Haunt these evil sylvari like a bad dream.
achievements.requirement: Kill  members of the Nightmare Court.

achievements.name: Ogre Slayer
achievements.description: Big and tough are only impressive if you're alive to show it off.
achievements.requirement: Kill  ogres.

achievements.name: Ooze Slayer
achievements.description: Hit them in the right spot and they make cool patterns in the mud.
achievements.requirement: Kill  oozes.

achievements.name: Pirate Slayer
achievements.description: The worst thing to happen to pirates since scurvy and sea monsters.
achievements.requirement: Kill  pirates.

achievements.name: Plant Slayer
achievements.description: These leafy monsters are now mulch.
achievements.requirement: Kill  plants.

achievements.name: Raptor Slayer
achievements.description: These birds of prey have met their predator.
achievements.requirement: Kill  raptors.

achievements.name: Skelk Slayer
achievements.description: These tricky hunters learned the hard way you were the most dangerous game.
achievements.requirement: Kill  skelk.

achievements.name: Sons of Svanir's Bane
achievements.description: The only good ice dragon cultist is a dead ice dragon cultist.
achievements.requirement: Kill  members of the Sons of Svanir.

achievements.name: Troll Slayer
achievements.description: Even trolls can't stand such brutal onslaughts.
achievements.requirement: Kill  trolls.

achievements.name: Wind Rider Slayer
achievements.description: Tangling with you was the last stupid decision these smart creatures ever made.
achievements.requirement: Kill  wind riders.

achievements.name: Wurm Slayer
achievements.description: Slice these slimy things from top to bottom.
achievements.requirement: Kill  wurms.

achievements.name: Zhaitan's Bane
achievements.description: Zhaitan should have raised a better army.
achievements.requirement: Kill  members of Zhaitan's army.

achievements.name: Short-Bow Master
achievements.description: You deliver pain from a distance.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a short bow.

achievements.name: Mace Master
achievements.description: Blunt force trauma is your friend, and you enjoy sharing it with your enemies.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a mace.

achievements.name: Focus Master
achievements.description: Only fools see this as an ornament. Only a master knows how to channel magic through it.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a focus.

achievements.name: Greatsword Master
achievements.description: You know how to wield a finely crafted piece of forged brutality.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a greatsword.

achievements.name: Hammer Master
achievements.description: When you absolutely want to turn your foes into jelly, this is your weapon.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a hammer.

achievements.name: Warhorn Master
achievements.description: The sound of death marches upon your enemy.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a warhorn.

achievements.name: Pistol Master
achievements.description: You dispense death from the palm of your hand.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a pistol.

achievements.name: Rifle Master
achievements.description: You deftly mix precision and power with this two-handed weapon.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a rifle.

achievements.name: Torch Master
achievements.description: Bringing light to the darkness—forcefully.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a torch.

achievements.name: Shield Master
achievements.description: You know how to turn defense into offense.
achievements.requirement: Deliver  killing blows with a shield.

achievements.name: Crime and Punishment
achievements.description: Through valor and a thirst for justice, you earned Logan Thackeray's trust.
achievements.requirement: Complete the human personal story step "Breaking the Blade," "The Commander," or "The Trial of Julius Zamon."

achievements.name: Graduation Day
achievements.description: Your brains and brawn were tested, and you stopped an Inquest plot.
achievements.requirement: Complete the asura personal story step "Gadd's Last Gizmo," "Defusing the Problem," "Here, There, Everywhere," or "The Things We Do For Love."

achievements.name: Rising to the Challenge
achievements.description: Today, you proved your strength by stopping a threat to the lodge.
achievements.requirement: Complete the norn personal story step "Minotaur Rampant," "The Last of the Giant-Kings," or "The Wolf Havroun."

achievements.name: For the Legion!
achievements.description: You brought heat to the Flame Legion.
achievements.requirement: Complete the charr personal story step "Deadly Force," "Ghostbore Artillery," "Operation: Bulwark," or "Quick and Quiet."

achievements.name: Waking from the Nightmare
achievements.description: You were awakened in the Dream and beat back the nightmare threat.
achievements.requirement: Complete the sylvari personal story step "Beneath a Cold Moon," "Black Night, White Stag," "The Heart of Nightmare," or "The Knight's Duel."

achievements.name: A Season of Growth
achievements.description: Some victories are bittersweet, but they're victories nonetheless.
achievements.requirement: Complete the sylvari personal story step "A Vision of Darkness," "Eye of the Sun," "Shattered Light," or "Snuffing Out Embers."

achievements.name: Legacy Code
achievements.description: Your quick thinking and actions stopped an error in your past from causing disaster in the present.
achievements.requirement: Complete the asura personal story step "Flash Flood," "Magnum Opus," or "Split Second."

achievements.name: Bloodying the Past
achievements.description: You have faced down the past, proving once again your might and wits.
achievements.requirement: Complete the charr personal story step "Dishonorable Discharge," "In the Ruins," "Sins of the Father," "Thicker Than Water," or "Tribunes in Effigy."

achievements.name: Family Reunion
achievements.description: You dealt with your past, and now you may join the world moving forward.
achievements.requirement: Complete the human personal story step "Ashes of the Past," "Liberation," or "The Ringmaster."

achievements.name: Things Best Left Behind
achievements.description: You cleaved an embarrassment from your past.
achievements.requirement: Complete the norn personal story step "Preserving the Balance," "The Championship Fight," or "The Machine in Action."

achievements.name: Something Lost, Something Gained
achievements.description: Despite a setback, you find yourself ready to embark on a larger adventure.
achievements.requirement: Complete the asura personal story step "A Meeting of the Minds," "Lines of Communication," or "Rakt and Ruin."

achievements.name: From Howl to Silence
achievements.description: Your honor is restored. However, you must prepare for a greater danger.
achievements.requirement: Complete the charr personal story step "Ever Vigilant," "Research and Destroy," or "Whispers of Vengeance."

achievements.name: Storming the Castle
achievements.description: You saved Queen Jennah from an insidious plot.
achievements.requirement: Complete the human personal story step "Kellach's Attack," "The Queen's Justice," or "The Trap."

achievements.name: Brawn over Brains
achievements.description: You destroyed the Dredge weapon and brought a fellow norn back on the path of destiny.
achievements.requirement: Complete the norn personal story step "Assault the Hill," "Sever the Head," or "Silent Warfare."

achievements.name: Branching Out
achievements.description: You made sure the dead stayed dead.
achievements.requirement: Complete the sylvari personal story step "A Tangle of Weeds," "Dead of Winter," or "Flower of Death."

achievements.name: Some Must Fight, That All May Be Free
achievements.description: You have become a full member of the Vigil.
achievements.requirement: Complete the story step "Minister's Defense" or "Quaestor's Siege."

achievements.name: A Friend In Deed
achievements.description: You came to the aid of another race under threat by the dragons.
achievements.requirement: Complete the story step "Attempted Deicide," "Evacuation," "Set to Blow," "The Lost Chieftain's Return," or "Unholy Grounds."

achievements.name: This Far, No Further
achievements.description: You liberated Claw Island from the undead and swore to strike back at the heart of Orr.
achievements.requirement: Complete the personal story step "Retribution."

achievements.name: The Cost of Victory
achievements.description: You faced your worst fear and emerged triumphant.
achievements.requirement: Complete the personal story step "A Sad Duty," "Delivering Justice," or "Liberating Apatia."

—Councillor Phlunt

Quaggans want give them friendship bracelets. Will you be quaggans' friend? Consider your reply carefully as you seek to attain the legendary precursor Rage.

achievements.name: Mistward Plate

achievements.name: Twilight I: The Experimental Nightsword
achievements.description: All things must end, all kingdoms must perish, and every day must finish in the fall of night. Consider the finality of all things by meditating on the transience of power and glory throughout Tyria, all in order to take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor known as Dusk.

achievements.name: Never Say Die
achievements.description: Story Instance: "City of Hope"
achievements.requirement: Complete the trial of strength with no deaths.

achievements.name: Mother of Wyverns
achievements.description: Those are her babies and grandbabies you've been killing...
achievements.requirement: Defeat the wyvern matriarch after nightfall in Verdant Brink.

achievements.name: Tendril Torchers: Silver
achievements.requirement: Burn tendrils and avoid unexploded shot before time runs out!

achievements.name: Ley Line Glider
achievements.requirement: Glide along ley lines in Dragon's Stand.

achievements.name: Scribe
achievements.description: Serious penmanship.
achievements.requirement: Reach rating  in the scribing discipline.

achievements.name: Powered Up
achievements.description: Those outposts won't start themselves.
achievements.requirement: Participate in powering up each of the outposts around Auric Basin.

achievements.name: The Dreamer III: The Lover
achievements.description: Desire leads to dreams, and the passions of the heart to the yearnings of the soul. Some dreams are bright, some are dark, some are for things lost, and some are for things yet to be. Gather these fragments of dreams and desires to channel into your efforts to create the legendary precursor known as The Lover.

achievements.name: Diarmid Dropper
achievements.description: Your machete may not be enough...
achievements.requirement: Defeat Blighted Diarmid.

achievements.name: Haywire Punch-o-Matic Battle: Silver
achievements.requirement: Smash some chak!

achievements.name: Ordnance Corps Auxiliary
achievements.description: Raze some hell!
achievements.requirement: Complete the Ordnance Corps outpost.

achievements.name: Wild Abandon
achievements.requirement: Collect these  items and skins to receive the berserker's torch, Wild Abandon.

achievements.name: Astralaria III: The Mechanism
achievements.description: The heavens grant their gifts to Tyria in the form of meteors that streak across our skies. Gather the ore of these fallen stars and use it to craft the spinning armillary that will eventually rest in the heart of your legendary weapon. Do this to create The Mechanism, the next step of your quest to attain Astralaria.

achievements.name: BUY-2046 PFR's Challenge #103
achievements.description: Once you've proven your fractal prowess, BUY-2046 PFR will sell you Fractal Gear Boxes containing your choice of fractal weapon skins.
achievements.requirement: Complete difficulty scale 50 in the Fractals of the Mists.

achievements.name: Bugs in the Branches: Silver
achievements.requirement: Jump and glide to collect bugs before time runs out!

achievements.name: Dive Master: Chak Hive
achievements.requirement: Use the diving goggles near the SCAR outpost.

achievements.name: "Whitebear's Pride II" Strongbox
achievements.requirement: Search in the Northern Confluence Passage area for the strongbox from the "Whitebear's Pride II."

achievements.name: The Juggernaut I: The Experimental Hammer
achievements.description: The wonders of the stone and soil, carved by nature and by sentient races, exude both power and stability. Meditate on these great places in order to take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor known as The Colossus.

achievements.name: Shooting Star
achievements.requirement: Use stealth gliding to reach the Mordrem Vineyard.

achievements.name: Establishing a Foothold
achievements.description: Journal: Establishing a Foothold Completed
achievements.requirement: Speak to Pact members for information.

achievements.name: Meteorlogicus I: The Experimental Scepter
achievements.description: The power of the elements are some of the greatest powers in Tyria. Journey through the land and experience the fury of its storms and the might of its creatures as you begin your personal journey to create the legendary precursor Storm.

achievements.name: Luminate's Backplate
achievements.requirement: Collect all  items to forge the ascended backpack, Luminate's Backplate.

achievements.name: Buried Insight
achievements.description: Journal: Buried Insight Completed
achievements.requirement: Search for ancient research on the Elder Dragons.

achievements.name: Chak Killer—Master
achievements.description: Story Instance: "Roots of Terror"
achievements.requirement: Jump into the pit and kill chak.

achievements.name: "Plains of Golghein" Strongbox

achievements.name: Astralaria II: The Apparatus
achievements.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Mechanism has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

achievements.name: Master Tempest
achievements.requirement: Completely train the elementalist's Tempest elite specialization.

achievements.name: Meteorlogicus III: Storm
achievements.description: Power, regardless of origin, is only of use when it is properly mastered, and to control the elements, one must understand the nature of control itself. Consider the nature of control, those who control, and those who are controlled, in your quest to attain the legendary precursor Storm.

achievements.name: HOPE I: Research
achievements.description: The froglike hylek are Tyria's best alchemists, the masters of potion and poison. Take the role of the apprentice in discovering the secrets of their work to create research, the first step in attaining the Hylek Optimized Projectile Experiment (HOPE).

achievements.name: Ydalir
achievements.requirement: Collect these  items and skins to receive the dragonhunter's bow, Ydalir.

achievements.name: Archeotech Adept
achievements.description: You've learned how to repair the archaic technology in Rata Novus.
achievements.requirement: Collect all of the parts needed to repair the ancient broken golem in Rata Novus.

achievements.description: Story Instance: Prisoners of the Dragon
achievements.requirement: When gliding down into the Mordrem prison camp, land within the marked target zone.

achievements.name: The Juggernaut III: The Colossus
achievements.description: The power of the earth is not only in its strength but in its fluid nature, moving slowly as stone should not move. Collect and bond with the oozes that live in the heart of the world to solve their mysteries and create the legendary precursor The Colossus.

achievements.name: Dug In
achievements.description: Story Instance: "Torn from the Sky"
achievements.requirement: Help the soldiers build up their defenses.

achievements.name: Revenant: Corruption

achievements.name: Master Berserker
achievements.requirement: Completely train the warrior's berserker elite specialization.

achievements.name: Hearts and Minds
achievements.description: Journal: Hearts and Minds Completed
achievements.requirement: Survive a long-awaited confrontation.

achievements.name: Amber Wurmslayer
achievements.requirement: Kill the amber head of the great jungle wurm in Bloodtide Coast.

achievements.name: No Lasers!
achievements.requirement: Defeat the Jade Maw without anyone in your party being hit by its beam attack.

achievements.name: Dark Harvest
achievements.requirement: Collect these  items and skins to receive the reaper's greatsword, Dark Harvest.

achievements.name: Frostfang I: The Experimental Axe
achievements.description: The power of Jormag and the other Elder Dragons seeped into the lands of Tyria during the long epochs while they slept. Upwellings of this power may be found throughout the land, for those who know where to look and how to capture it. Let finding this power be the first part of your journey to craft the legendary precursor Tooth of Frostfang.

achievements.name: The Flameseeker Prophecies I: The Experimental Shield
achievements.description: Tyria is a land of heroes and villains locked in eternal struggle. Attain the "Anthology of Villains," and record the tales of the defeat of the most dastardly of their lot. Meditate upon the nature of villainy as you take the first steps in creating the legendary precursor known as The Chosen.

achievements.name: Bolt III: Zap
achievements.description: Brilliance strikes like a bolt from the blue, and that electric shock of imagination applies to both wielding and crafting the mightiest of weapons. Gather the energies of Tyria to infuse them into a superior weapon in your journey to craft the legendary precursor Zap.

achievements.name: The Dreamer I: The Experimental Short Bow
achievements.description: The heart hunts on a lonely train, plagued by desire, sadness, and occasionally joy. It pervades Tyria and its people. Track down these moments of the heart throughout the land in your first steps to create the legendary precursor The Lover.

achievements.name: Shut the Doors
achievements.requirement: Complete  door event in Mad King's Labyrinth.

achievements.name: Kraitkin I: The Experimental Trident
achievements.description: Versatile, flexible, and strong; tentacles invoke a feeling of strangeness and otherworldliness. Meditate on the virtues of such tentacled beasts as wind riders and jellyfish as you take your first steps in attaining the legendary precursor Venom.

achievements.name: The Floor Is Lava?: Silver
achievements.requirement: Kick rockvine fruit and retrieve as many spores as you can before time runs out!

achievements.name: Adept Herald
achievements.requirement: Begin training the revenant's herald elite specialization.

achievements.requirement: Follow Taimi's trail further into the jungle.

achievements.requirement: Search in the Creeping Crevasse area for the strongbox from the "Lethal Vantage."

achievements.requirement: Collect all  items to forge your Machined Warhorn.

achievements.requirement: Complete all  Heart of Thorns Act II achievements.

achievements.requirement: Search in the Bristleback Chasm area for the strongbox from the "Obsidian Triumph."

achievements.requirement: Begin training the guardian's dragonhunter elite specialization.

achievements.description: Chak killing machine!
achievements.requirement: Successfully participate in the SCAR lane for the entirety of the King of the Jungle battle.

achievements.name: Quip III: Chaos Gun
achievements.description: Confetti bombs. Sigils of Mischief. Laughter. Pies. These are the weapons of a master prankster, used to embarrass the mighty and the might-be alike. Master these malicious matters of mischief in your efforts to craft the legendary precursor known as the Chaos Gun.

achievements.name: Predatory Prey
achievements.description: Story Instance: "City of Hope"
achievements.requirement: Defeat all enemies in the teamwork trial.

achievements.name: Beetle Feast: Silver
achievements.requirement: Eat yellow mushrooms to score points and blue mushrooms to gain abilities that help you in your hunt. Beware of the poisonous mushrooms with green spores, and use your burrow ability to bypass closed gates!

achievements.name: The Predator's Path
achievements.description: Journal: The Predator's Path Completed
achievements.requirement: Catch up with the rest of your team.

achievements.name: Nevermore I: Ravenswood Branch
achievements.description: The bounty of Tyria's nature is immense but not without limit, and as such must be cultivated, encouraged, and most of all protected. Get in touch with nature of Tyria in your quest to create the Ravenswood Branch, the first of the precursors to the legendary staff, Nevermore.

achievements.name: Mistward Headwrap
achievements.requirement: Unlock the rest of the Mistward armor set to earn your headwrap.

achievements.name: The Bifrost I: The Experimental Staff
achievements.description: The Jotun Star, fabled relic of the ancient mystical race, was said to call down a rainbow to the land. The stone, and its power, was broken long ago. Help bring it to rest as the first part of your journey to craft the legendary precursor The Legend.

achievements.name: Roots of Terror
achievements.description: Journal: Roots of Terror Completed
achievements.requirement: Search for valuable intel in the battle against Mordremoth.

achievements.name: Skritt Salvager
achievements.description: Show me the shinies!
achievements.requirement: Loot a skritt burglar's treasure chest.

achievements.name: The Predator I: The Experimental Rifle
achievements.description: The rifle, whether it fires bullets or magical rays, is one of the most complex common weapons of Tyria. Understand its wonders by researching the technology of such weapons as you take your first steps in the personal journey to create the legendary precursor known as The Hunter.

achievements.name: Kamohoali'i Kotaki III: Carcharias
achievements.description: The sea is wide and mighty, and conceals both great dangers and wondrous prizes. Dive into it, explore its depths, and swim deep beneath its ever-shifting surface in your journey to create the legendary precursor known as Carcharias.

achievements.name: The Flameseeker Prophecies III: The Chosen
achievements.description: Tyria is a land of heroes and villains locked in eternal struggle. Attain the "Anthology of Heroes," and record the tales of the greatest of their number, both from the past and the heroes of today. Consider the true nature of heroism in your efforts to craft the legendary precursor known as The Chosen.

achievements.name: Avoid Traps
achievements.description: Story Instance: "Strange Observations"
achievements.requirement: Find Taimi without stepping on any Mordrem traps.

achievements.description: Privileged to be here!
achievements.requirement: Complete the Noble Crash Site outpost.

achievements.name: Ascended Recycling
achievements.requirement: Collect and consume  powerful items from salvaging ascended gear.

achievements.name: Ongoing Defense
achievements.description: Job's not done yet...
achievements.requirement: Defend one of the completed Pact towers when it falls under attack.

achievements.name: "Scorchrazor II" Strongbox
achievements.requirement: Search in the Central Barbed Gate area for the strongbox from the "Scorchrazor II."

achievements.name: Machined Focus
achievements.requirement: Collect all  items to forge your Machined Focus.

achievements.name: Beetle Feast: Gold
achievements.requirement: Eat yellow mushrooms to score points and blue mushrooms to gain abilities that help you in your hunt. Beware of the poisonous mushrooms with green spores, and use your burrow ability to bypass closed gates!

achievements.name: Adept Tempest
achievements.requirement: Begin training the elementalist's tempest elite specialization.

achievements.name: Old Tom
achievements.requirement: Unlock  cat golem miniatures.

achievements.name: Tarnished Traitor
achievements.description: Find this lost Exalted below the city of Tarir.
achievements.requirement: Summon and defeat / tarnished traitor.

achievements.name: Nevermore IV: The Raven Spirit
achievements.description: Take upon yourself the responsibility of raising a raven from egg to chick to adult, while you work toward taming the wild raven spirit you have already caught. With the blessings of the Great Spirit, Raven, these two are destined to join together, earning you the Gift of the Raven Spirit, the penultimate step to attaining the legendary staff, Nevermore.

achievements.name: Cleaning House
achievements.description: Story Instance: "Buried Insight"
achievements.requirement: Locate and destroy all of the active Rata Novan security mechanisms throughout the city.

achievements.name: "Mellaggan's Valor" Strongbox
achievements.requirement: Search in the Blighted Depths area for the strongbox from the "Mellaggan's Valor."

achievements.name: Mouth of Mordremoth Slayer
achievements.description: Concentrated ley energy is off today's menu.
achievements.requirement: Slay the Mouth of Mordremoth in Dragon's Stand.

achievements.name: Champion Chak Hunter
achievements.description: No chak is safe.
achievements.requirement: Kill  champion chak.

achievements.name: Ultimate Challenge Winner
achievements.description: You won all the outpost challenges around Auric Basin.
achievements.requirement: Place first in all the outpost challenges around Auric Basin.

achievements.name: HOPE III: Prototype
achievements.description: As the hylek are masters of alchemy, so too are the asura the wizards of technomagical research. They understand the forces in play in their Eternal Alchemy and how to apply them to the greater world. Uncover their secrets in your work to attain Prototype, the next step in your legendary journey for attaining HOPE.

achievements.name: Ad Infinitum II: Upper Bound
achievements.description: Unlock all 11 fractal tier 2 components to work towards building the legendary fractal backpack.
achievements.requirement: Collect all  fractal tier 2 components.

achievements.name: Flying Circus: Silver
achievements.requirement: Glide through the glowing rings and reach the finish line as fast as possible!

achievements.name: Line of Fire
achievements.description: Story Instance: "Bitter Harvest"
achievements.requirement: Defeat the Mordrem snipers.

achievements.name: Wartime Sommelier
achievements.description: First class all the way!
achievements.requirement: Find some wine in the wreckage and serve one of the nobles.

achievements.name: Incinerator I: The Experimental Dagger
achievements.description: From the heart of the furnace, the elements dance and caper at your command! Many rare and unusual elements are needed for your journey, and you must capture and comprehend them all in order to take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor Spark.

achievements.name: "Endurance" Strongbox
achievements.requirement: Search in the Griffonfall area for the strongbox from the "Endurance."

achievements.name: Sky Commander
achievements.description: Master of all you survey!
achievements.requirement: Defeat all nightfall bosses in Verdant Brink.

achievements.name: Firestorm Extinguisher
achievements.requirement: Defeat the Molten Firestorm before defeating the Molten Berserker in the first phase of the encounter, then defeat the upgraded Molten Berserker in the second phase of the encounter in the Molten Boss fractal.

achievements.name: Forgotten City Arches
achievements.description: Use your glider to experience the beauty of Tarir.
achievements.requirement: Glide through / arches below the waterfall on the eastern side of Tarir.

achievements.name: Machined Axe
achievements.requirement: Collect all  items to forge your Machined Axe.

achievements.name: The Most Dangerous Game
achievements.description: No, the prey isn't human...
achievements.requirement: Reach and complete the final stage of an Itzel hunting excursion.

achievements.name: Astralaria I: The Device
achievements.description: The saying goes—the history of Tyria is written in the stars, and indeed the tales of the past and hints of the future are inscribed in the heavens. Help Ogden Stonehealer in revealing and gathering ancient knowledge in your quest to create the Device, the first of the precursors to the legendary axe Astralaria.

achievements.name: Warmaster's Pack
achievements.requirement: Collect all  items to construct your Warmaster's Pack.

achievements.name: Bronzer
achievements.description: It won't turn your skin orange, unless you already are...
achievements.requirement: Earn a bronze medal or better on all 5 adventures in Verdant Brink.

achievements.name: Treetop Retriever
achievements.description: They made the ultimate sacrifice.
achievements.requirement: Locate the 10 lost Priory corpses in the Tarnished Treetop of Auric Basin.
